full_description:
Learn how to use ChatGPT as a practical assistant for workplace communication, document preparation, business research, data analysis and everyday professional tasks.

This hands-on ChatGPT for Work, Research & Data Analysis course teaches effective AI instructions, responsible tool selection, professional writing, document review, spreadsheet interpretation and research workflows.

Develop practical skills in drafting emails, preparing executive reports, reviewing proposals, structuring presentations, analyzing uploaded datasets, generating charts and interpreting business KPIs.

Learn how to verify calculations, assess source reliability, compare documents, review research findings and identify limitations in AI-generated results.

Explore ChatGPT Projects, reusable instructions, structured working processes, supported plugins and connected tools according to their actual availability.

Understand when standard ChatGPT conversations, search, data analysis, deep research or ChatGPT Work are appropriate for a task, without assuming every feature is available on every account.

Build a professional ChatGPT Business Productivity Toolkit containing an analyzed business dataset, an executive report, a verified research brief, professional communication assets and a documented reusable workflow.

The programme emphasizes human judgment, accuracy, privacy, practical business value and repeatable quality-controlled outcomes.

It is designed for students, freelancers, marketers, business owners and professionals who want to become productive and responsible ChatGPT users without learning programming or AI infrastructure engineering.

faq.question: What is ChatGPT for Work, Research & Data Analysis?
faq.answer: ChatGPT for Work, Research & Data Analysis is a practical, job-aligned certification course that teaches professionals, freelancers, and students how to utilize ChatGPT as an everyday workplace partner. You will learn to draft high-impact business documents, analyze spreadsheets and CSV files, verify calculation formulas, conduct evidence-based web research, and standardize recurring tasks into repeatable, quality-controlled workflows.

faq.question: Is the course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course is designed for beginner to applied learners. You only need basic computer literacy and familiarity with standard office documents and spreadsheets. No programming knowledge, Python background, or advanced mathematics is required; all instruction focuses on practical software interfaces and workplace deliverables.

faq.question: What is the course duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course spans 5 Weeks with 40 total instructional hours (8 hours per week: 4 hours of live instruction plus 4 hours of supervised studio lab). The transparent institutional tuition is exactly ₹5,900 (+ applicable GST), adhering strictly to Truth in Pricing with zero artificial countdown discounts or inflated strike-throughs. Flexible two-installment payment options are available.

faq.question: Do I need coding knowledge?
faq.answer: No. This course is strictly focused on applied business productivity, writing, and data analysis using ChatGPT's web interface and office software. You will not be required to write Python scripts, build API pipelines, or learn programming languages.

faq.question: Will I learn professional email and report writing?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 02 is entirely dedicated to workplace communication. You will learn to draft executive emails, client proposals, complaint resolutions, presentation slide decks, and formal reports, mastering tone modulation, brand voice consistency, and structured human editorial reviews.

faq.question: Will I learn to analyze Excel and CSV files?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 03 teaches you how to upload spreadsheets, inspect dataset structures, clean missing or duplicate records, filter columns, calculate business KPIs, and generate visual charts and performance summaries using ChatGPT's data analysis capabilities.

faq.question: Does the course cover charts and KPI reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn how to create and interpret appropriate charts (bar charts, line graphs, donut charts) and calculate essential business metrics such as lead-to-admission conversion rates, average order values, and month-over-month growth rates.

faq.question: Will I learn to verify AI-generated calculations?
faq.answer: Yes, calculation verification is a mandatory competency. You will learn independent cross-checking protocols using spreadsheet formulas to verify totals, percentages, and conversion ratios, ensuring you never trust AI mathematical outputs without independent validation.

faq.question: Does the course teach web research?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 04 covers web-assisted research, teaching you how to define research questions, evaluate source authority and freshness, compare conflicting findings, detect fabricated citations, and synthesize structured research briefs.

faq.question: What is the difference between Search and Deep Research?
faq.answer: Standard ChatGPT Search provides fast, web-grounded retrieval for immediate questions and factual lookups. Deep Research (where accessible) conducts multi-step, iterative evidence gathering across dozens of sources for complex, comprehensive briefs. We explain when to use each and how to audit all cited references.

faq.question: Will I learn ChatGPT Projects?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn how to set up ChatGPT Projects to organize workstreams, attach permanent reference files (brand guidelines, templates, datasets), and define reusable custom instructions for recurring tasks.

faq.question: Does the course include ChatGPT Work?
faq.answer: Yes, we introduce ChatGPT Work concepts where available, explaining how multi-step workflows, finished document preparation, and workspace collaboration operate, while noting account and plan availability boundaries.

faq.question: Will I learn about ChatGPT plugins?
faq.answer: Yes. We teach plugins and connected app integrations as optional capabilities, covering discovery, account authorization, workspace permissions, read vs write boundaries, and data access revocation.

faq.question: Do I need a paid ChatGPT plan?
faq.answer: No. You can complete the core curriculum using standard or free ChatGPT accounts combined with common office tools. We explain the features available across free, Plus, Team, and Enterprise plans, providing platform-neutral alternative workflows whenever advanced features vary.

faq.question: Can ChatGPT make mistakes?
faq.answer: Yes. ChatGPT can hallucinate, produce incorrect calculations, misunderstand context, or reference outdated information. This course emphasizes human quality control, teaching rigorous verification checklists for all writing, math, and research before deliverables are used.

faq.question: How is private business data handled?
faq.answer: Data privacy is a foundational topic (Module 01). You will learn how to identify sensitive, proprietary, and personal data, anonymize records before upload, navigate ChatGPT Data Controls and chat history settings, and comply with organizational privacy policies.

faq.question: What practical portfolio will I build?
faq.answer: You will build the five-component ChatGPT Business Productivity Toolkit: (1) Business Data Analysis Workbook, (2) AI-Assisted Executive Performance Report, (3) Evidence-Based Business Research Brief, (4) Workplace Communication Portfolio, and (5) Documented Reusable Business Workflow.

faq.question: Does this course include OpenAI API development?
faq.answer: No. API programming, Python SDK development, and backend software engineering are excluded. This course is dedicated to end-user workplace productivity and business deliverables.

faq.question: Does the course teach advanced AI agents?
faq.answer: No. Autonomous multi-agent systems and complex agent architectures belong to Course 43 and advanced AI engineering tracks. Course 44 focuses on direct, human-supervised productivity within ChatGPT.

faq.question: Is this an official OpenAI certification?
faq.answer: Upon successful completion of all coursework and project assessments, Nova Skills awards an institutional Certificate of Completion in ChatGPT for Work, Research & Data Analysis. This is an institution-issued credential verifying your practical training and portfolio deliverables; it is not an official vendor credential issued by OpenAI or Microsoft.

faq.question: What career applications can I explore?
faq.answer: Graduates apply these skills in roles such as AI-Assisted Office Productivity Specialist, Business Documentation Assistant, Reporting & Analysis Assistant, AI Research Support Executive, Administrative Productivity Specialist, and AI Productivity Freelancer across modern corporate and agency environments.
